name: Tsitsi Dangarembga
shortBio: Zimbabwean postcolonial feminist thinker, novelist, and filmmaker whose Nervous Conditions deepened Sartre and Fanon’s diagnosis of colonial neurosis through gendered Shona experience.
centralQuestion: How does the "nervous condition" of colonial education fracture African women between assimilation, hunger, and self-recovery?

keyWorks.title: Nervous Conditions
keyWorks.description: Philosophical novel extending Sartre’s preface to Fanon to trace embodied alienation and rebellion in colonial Rhodesia.
